chunks.text: Basis: consolidated IFRS. Currency: USD million. Years ended March 31. FY2025 / FY2024: revenue 19277 / 18562; operating profit 4071 / 3834; PBT 4447 / 4346; net profit after minority interest 3158 / 3167; cash and equivalents 2861 / 1773. Q4 FY2025 / Q4 FY2024: revenue 4730 / 4564; operating profit 992 / 917; PBT 1117 / 1232; net profit after minority interest 813 / 958.
FY2025 constant-currency revenue growth 4.2%; operating margin 21.1%; free cash flow USD 4088 million. These are fiscal-year results, not Q4 growth metrics.
we are revising our FY'25 revenue guidance to 4.5% to 5% in constant currency terms.

chunks.section: Board’s report — revenue distribution by business segments
chunks.text: FY2025 consolidated revenue mix: financial services and insurance 27.7%; retail, consumer packaged goods and logistics 13.5%; communication, telecom OEM and media 11.7%; energy, utilities, resources and services 13.3%; manufacturing 15.5%; hi-tech 8.0%; life sciences and healthcare 7.3%; others 3.0%.

chunks.section: Management Discussion and Analysis — Financial Performance Overview
chunks.text: Basis: consolidated Ind AS, INR crore. FY2025 revenue 255324; EBIT before other income 62165; PAT attributable to shareholders 48553; operating margin 24.3%; net margin 19.0%. FY2024 revenue 240893. Reported revenue growth 6.0%; constant-currency growth 4.2%. The FY2024 EBIT and PAT comparatives in this section exclude a legal claim settlement; do not compare them as unadjusted reported profits.

Management reported decision delays and closer scrutiny of discretionary spending in April 2025, with increased macroeconomic and geopolitical uncertainty since January. These are management observations, not independently established causal explanations.

chunks.section: Consolidated statement of profit and loss
chunks.text: Basis: consolidated Ind AS, INR crore. FY2025 / FY2024: revenue 117055 / 109913; PBT 23261 / 20967; total PAT 17399 / 15710; depreciation and amortization 4084 / 4173; finance costs 644 / 553.

chunks.section: Consolidated statement of profit and loss — attribution
chunks.text: Basis: consolidated Ind AS, INR crore. PAT attributable to owners of the company: FY2025 17390; FY2024 15702. Minority interest in PAT: FY2025 9; FY2024 8.

FY2025 segment revenue, INR crore, before elimination: IT and Business Services 86438; Engineering and R&D Services 18960; HCLSoftware 12049. These segment totals include inter-segment revenues and must not be summed as consolidated revenue.

FY2025, USD billion: operating cash flow 2.63; free cash flow 2.5; gross cash 3.62; net cash 3.35. Management reported operating cash flow to net income conversion 129% and free cash flow to net income 123%.

chunks.section: Consolidated statement of profit and loss
chunks.text: Basis: consolidated Ind AS, INR crore. FY2025 / FY2024: revenue from operations 81612.78 / 73891.43; PBT continuing operations 26926.94 / 26400.28; PAT continuing operations 20036.47 / 20190.82; total PAT including discontinued operations 35052.48 / 20751.36. FY2025 discontinued operations include exceptional income 15128.81. Total PAT growth is not an underlying operating growth measure.

chunks.section: Note 23B — gross revenue from products and services
chunks.text: FY2025 gross product and service revenue: INR 80942.76 crore. Includes cigarettes, packaged foods and other FMCG; agriculture; paperboards, paper and packaging; and other activities including IT services. The gross amount includes specified excise and similar duties and excludes other operating revenue; it differs from total revenue from operations.

chunks.section: Major associate of the group — ITC Hotels Limited
chunks.text: The hotels business was demerged into ITC Hotels effective January 1, 2025. ITC held 39.88% of ITC Hotels. Continuing and discontinued operations are separately disclosed in the annual results.

realityCheck.quote: we are revising our FY'25 revenue guidance to 4.5% to 5% in constant currency terms.
realityCheck.interpretation: FY2025 constant-currency revenue growth finished 0.3 percentage points below the lower end of the January 2025 guidance range. This compares a specific guidance vintage with the subsequent annual outcome; it does not establish why the miss occurred.
